data.name: Cyntessa
data.description:
Apperance
In "Mass Destruction," it was revealed that the Solver killed Tessa and later grafted her corpse onto Cyn's body, fusing them together. Her appearance resembles a rotting human-child corpse grafted with a Worker Drone. She still wears a short, black dress, but it's been tattered, and has black heels. She has black hair and a bow on her head. Her eye sockets are dark and glow with X-shapes colored in neon yellow and she has numerous jagged sharp teeth with a dark gray tongue. A ripped part of her corpse reveals the drone identification number on her chest to be 1001. Her human hands also protrude above her drone hands which her hands also hang freely from her wrists, with Tessa's human hands draped on top. She also had fleshy-like large tendrils poking out on her back; Three intestine-like tentacles protrude out of the hybrid form's back in a similar arrangement to the Absolute Solver Translate symbol, which she uses to stand and walk around on.

Personality
Due to never being present as herself, it isn't easy to ascertain Cyn's actual mannerisms. That being said, when puppeteered by the Absolute Solver, she comes off as having a chilling personality that scares those around her due to her mental and physical deformities. Lacking any semblance of emotions, she resorts to using mimicry and imitation to behave like a real person would, speaking her actions aloud ("light sip", "sheepish nod", "giggle"), but she was capable of actually laughing. Her posture and gait are awkward, stilted, and off-balance. Her neck joint was also loose, and she had to support her head with her hand.

Abilities
Ability	Function
Absolute Solver

Telekinesis	Just like drones who are infected by the Absolute Solver, Cyn can move objects without directly touching them while under the control of the Absolute Solver. 

Teleportation	Just like drones who are infected by the Absolute Solver, Cyn can teleport anywhere under the control of the Absolute Solver.

Eldritch Transformation	Cyn was shown to transform into a large biomechanical eldritch centipede robot in "Home." This is her actual form. 

Electrokinesis	Cyn, under the control of the Absolute Solver, was shown to be able to turn off all the lights at the gala/cathedral.

Black Hole Creation	Cyn, under the control of the Absolute Solver, created a black hole that destroyed the Earth.
Expert Handwork	Cyn, under the control of the Absolute Solver, possesses sufficient skill to graft 
Tessa's corpse onto her body.

Shapeshifting	In Absolute End, she is able to change herself in different characters. However, it is unknown how long she can last in the current character she has turned herself into.

Blood as oil. But cyntessa is blood and oil
